headword: {医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}

definitions.explanation: An income tax deduction that allows Japanese taxpayers to deduct qualifying medical expenses above a certain threshold (generally ¥100,000 per year) from their taxable income. Claimed by filing a final tax return ({確定申告|かくていしんこく}).

examples.japanese: {医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To apply for the medical expense deduction.

examples.japanese: {医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}している→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm keeping the receipts for the medical expense deduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一年間|いちねんかん}→一年間：28882_ichinenkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}→医療費：24692_iryouhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十万円|じゅうまんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えれば→超える：01942_koeru⟧{医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: If your annual medical expenses exceed 100,000 yen, you can receive the medical expense deduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、{医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When filing your tax return, don't forget to claim the medical expense deduction.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}→医療費：24692_iryouhi⟧ (medical expenses) + ⟦{控除|こうじょ}→控除：07501_koujo⟧ (deduction, subtraction). A specific category of {所得控除|しょとくこうじょ} (income deduction) in the Japanese tax system. Generally, the portion of household medical expenses exceeding ¥100,000 per year (or 5% of total income, whichever is lower) can be deducted from taxable income.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive the medical expense deduction
- {医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for the medical expense deduction
- {医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: eligible for the medical expense deduction
- {医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧: the upper limit of the medical expense deduction

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧: final tax return — the process through which the deduction is claimed
- {所得控除|しょとくこうじょ}: income deduction — the broader category
- ⟦{扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}→扶養控除：23325_fuyoukoujo⟧: dependent deduction — another category of income deduction
- ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧: receipt — required as proof of medical expenses

USAGE:
Eligible expenses include doctor visits, prescription medication, hospital stays, dental care, and certain transportation costs to medical appointments. The claim is made annually by filing a tax return with a summary of the year's medical expenses.
